title: Explicit logarithmic-depth majority formulas using only three-input majority gates and variables
author: Alexander Kozachinskiy and Vladimir V. Podolskii
work: Multiparty Karchmer--Wigderson Games and Threshold Circuits
source_version: Theory of Computing18 (2022), Article15, publisher source publicationJune 12, 2022; DOI10.4086/toc.2022.v018a015

source_locator.proof_scope: Author complete Section8 direct proof1508–1608, explicitly matched to original primary conclusion

original_source_record.description: Exact source ZIP author gate-replacement figure, explicit PDF basename retained; not a proof-page image.

difficulty_reason: The selected research obligation is a uniform, constant-free three-input-majority construction for exact majority, beyond simply applying the known AKS monotone formula. The author's direct proof constructs paired gate replacements with a self-dual correctness condition, then assembles them through overlapping recursive covers while preserving logarithmic depth and polynomial-time constructibility. The complete transformation and induction are local author core, rather than an equivalent formulation or a routine check of an already supplied majority circuit.

source_check.note: Exact Theorem1.1 and author's complete direct Section8 proof1508–1608 selected, including the printed input/output transformation specification, self-duality observation, both gate cases, recursive union-cover construction, depth induction and explicit time bound. That transformation takes a monotone depth-d majority formula and outputs a MAJ3 formula of depth d+O(log n); the author explicitly plugs the cited AKS83 sorting-network-derived O(log n) formula1513–1518, giving exactly the original uniform primary conclusion. All gate constants are excluded in the source Q2/MAJ3 basis716 and the theorem's formula basis. Original transform.pdf is the author's gate-replacement illustration, retained exactly; full proof prose/formulas remain editable native TeX. The earlier first-proof helper native973 literally says w(r) has size2 at a leaf, while971 defines w(r)=[2n+1]. No correction supplied: that alternative branch remains unqualified original context and is not used by selected Section8. The paper's general multiparty equivalence897 is a distinct universal structural obligation; majority restatement4.1 and additional proofs are uncounted duplicates.
